title: Transmitter 8K.... doesn‘t connent
symptom: User tried to connect a G6 transmitter with ID starting 8K, but xDrip did not show 'Got Glucose' or 'Got no Raw'. The transmitter randomly appeared in Bluetooth but did not connect to xDrip. After 3 hours of toggling Bluetooth, the user started it with the original Dexcom Receiver, which worked within minutes.
cause: The logs show that no connection is being made successfully from the phone to the transmitter. The user suspects their phone (SM-A520F) with LineageOS 16.0 is incompatible.
evidence_quote: The logs show that no connection is being made successfully from the phone to the transmitter.
